methods.description: Count equal denominator-parts in the whole units, add the extra parts and keep the same denominator; a negative mixed numeral has the minus sign on the whole value.
Divide numerator by denominator to count whole groups and leftover parts; write the remainder over the same denominator, simplify if required, and omit the fraction when the remainder is zero.
For these terminating decimal conversions, convert a mixed numeral to improper if necessary, make an equivalent denominator10/100/1000 and read the whole and decimal places.
